description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 18.06.2018 to 24.06.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs valuation and financial compliance, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or any other specialized category.
